title: Bitcoin Genesis Block Day
notes: Satoshi mined block 0 on January 3, 2009, beginning the first durable decentralized monetary network.
angles: Explain the Times headline embedded in the genesis block; contrast Bitcoin's fixed monetary policy with discretionary money; show the growth from one block to a global settlement network.
formats: Historical carousel; timeline graphic; founder-style LinkedIn post; then-vs-now chart.

title: Proof of Keys Day
notes: Community-led reminder that holding a private key differs from holding a claim against an intermediary. Publish alongside Genesis Block Day or as a separate afternoon post.
angles: Self-custody versus qualified custody; counterparty risk without promoting unsafe practices; when institutional custody is appropriate.
formats: Educational carousel; custody comparison; client FAQ; short video.

title: U.S. Spot Bitcoin ETF Approval Day
notes: The SEC approved the first group of U.S. spot Bitcoin ETPs on January 10, 2024. Pull updated flow and AUM data 2-3 days before publishing.
angles: Chart cumulative ETF flows; compare direct ownership with ETF exposure; explain why regulated wrappers expanded access.
formats: Flow chart; institutional adoption carousel; newsletter section; client email.

title: First Bitcoin Transaction Day
notes: Satoshi sent 10 BTC to Hal Finney in 2009, demonstrating peer-to-peer value transfer on the live network. Include a source link or transaction reference.
angles: Story of early experimentation; compare with modern settlement volumes; how networks gain value through participation.
formats: Transaction explainer; timeline; animated map or block explorer visual.

title: Solana Genesis Day
notes: Solana launched mainnet beta from its genesis block on March 16, 2020. Update network and ecosystem statistics the week before.
angles: Why different blockchains optimize for different use cases; throughput, latency and ecosystem specialization; avoid framing protocol comparisons as zero-sum.
formats: Protocol profile; ecosystem statistics carousel; educational comparison.

title: Monero Birthday
notes: Monero launched in April 2014 as a major example of privacy-by-default digital cash. Compliance review recommended; avoid promotional investment language.
angles: Privacy and fungibility as monetary properties; distinguish lawful financial privacy from illicit activity; the compliance tension around privacy assets.
formats: Educational carousel; debate-style post; compliance perspective.

title: Bitcoin Pizza Day
notes: In 2010 Laszlo Hanyecz exchanged 10,000 BTC for two pizzas. Prepare the visual 10 days early; update the BTC conversion on the morning of publication.
angles: Use the story to explain bootstrapping a monetary network; avoid reducing it to 'the world's most expensive pizza'; early spending established utility and price discovery.
formats: Branded visual; pizza giveaway; 'what 10,000 BTC represents today' chart; community poll.

title: Ethereum Birthday
notes: Ethereum's genesis block launched July 30, 2015, introducing a general-purpose programmable blockchain. Update ecosystem metrics 2-3 days prior.
angles: Ethereum as an onchain settlement and application layer; map traditional markets to emerging tokenized markets; stablecoins, DeFi and tokenization.
formats: Market-map graphic; timeline; educational carousel; founder quote compilation.

title: Bitcoin Independence Day
notes: Commemorates the 2017 user-activated soft fork and the role users played in the blocksize conflict. Source-check the technical description and keep it accessible to nontechnical readers.
angles: Decentralized governance; why credible neutrality matters; how rules are enforced through voluntary network participation.
formats: Governance explainer; historical carousel; long-form LinkedIn post.

title: El Salvador Bitcoin Day
notes: Bitcoin became legal tender in El Salvador on September 7, 2021. Use current sources because the country's laws and implementation continue to evolve.
angles: What worked, what did not, what other countries can learn; remittances, tourism, financial inclusion and implementation challenges.
formats: Balanced case study; adoption timeline; data-led carousel.

title: Ethereum Merge Day
notes: Ethereum completed its transition from proof-of-work to proof-of-stake on September 15, 2022. Update staking and supply metrics before publishing.
angles: Operational significance of changing a live network's consensus mechanism; staking and network security; energy use before and after.
formats: Before-and-after chart; technical explainer; staking primer.

title: Litecoin Birthday
notes: Litecoin launched in October 2011 as one of the earliest alternative networks. Keep the post educational and historical.
angles: History of digital cash experimentation; why early networks matter even when attention moves elsewhere; compare design choices without price predictions.
formats: Crypto history timeline; protocol retrospective; trivia post.

title: Bitcoin Whitepaper Day
notes: Satoshi released 'Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System' on October 31, 2008. Begin two weeks early — this should be one of the highest-quality annual posts.
angles: One whitepaper concept per slide; double-spending, proof-of-work and peer-to-peer settlement; how a nine-page paper grew into a global asset class.
formats: Flagship carousel; annotated whitepaper; short video series; client letter.

title: Dogecoin Birthday
notes: Dogecoin launched in December 2013 and became a lasting example of internet culture creating a real economic community. Keep the tone playful but professional.
angles: Memes as coordination tools; community-driven network effects; distinguish cultural value from investment fundamentals.
formats: Lighthearted branded visual; community poll; culture explainer.
